title: Luxury Phuket, Koh Samui and Krabi
alt: Limestone stacks rising out of the water in Phang Nga Bay, Thailand
transport: Private and shared transfers with long tail boat, speedboat and ferry crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Ten nights, three coasts and a free day in each place. This is the version that actually feels like a holiday.
expert.tip: Do Phang Nga Bay early in your Phuket stay while the sea is calmest. On the Krabi 7 Islands tour, stay in the water after the barbecue because the plankton only glows once it is properly dark.

summary: Eleven days along the Thai coast in four and five star resorts. Phang Nga Bay by long tail boat, the Siam Niramit show, a tiger encounter, the Ang Thong marine park by speedboat and the Krabi 7 Islands with a barbecue dinner on the sand.
included: Included: 10 nights in 3 luxury resorts with daily breakfast; Siam Niramit show gold seats with shared transfers; James Bond island and Phang Nga Bay tour with sea canoeing; Tiger Kingdom big tiger encounter with private transfers; Ang Thong marine park speedboat tour; Krabi 7 Islands tour with barbecue dinner; 22 airport, pier and sightseeing transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; park and temple entry fees; meals other than those listed; personal expenses.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast included · Luxury room · 4★ · Fishermen's Harbour at the quiet end of Patong beach

program.name: Phang Nga Bay, tigers and a stage show
program.description: Four nights in Patong with a long tail boat day in Phang Nga Bay, the Siam Niramit show and a close up tiger encounter.

activities.name: Siam Niramit Show
activities.description: A large stage production on Thai history and legend with gold seats included, and shared transfers each way.

activities.name: Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island
activities.description: A long tail boat day into Phang Nga Bay, with the famous leaning stack, hidden sea caves and sea canoeing through the lagoons.

activities.name: Tiger Kingdom Phuket
activities.description: Time inside the enclosure with the big tigers, keepers beside you throughout, with private transfers each way.

activities.name: Phuket Elephant Sanctuary
activities.description: A no riding sanctuary in the hills near Paklok where rescued elephants roam, bathe and feed at their own pace.

stops.name: Koh Samui
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Luxury room · 5★ · Nora Buri, built into the headland above Chaweng bay

program.name: Chaweng and the Ang Thong islands
program.description: Three nights on Samui with a speedboat day in the Ang Thong marine park and a full day left open on the beach.

activities.name: Ang Thong Marine Park by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day out to forty two islands with a hidden lagoon, snorkelling stops and a viewpoint climb on Koh Wua Talap.

activities.name: Fisherman's Village
activities.description: Old wooden shophouses at Bophut turned into cafes and bars, with a walking street market on Friday evenings.

activities.name: Big Buddha Temple
activities.description: Wat Phra Yai on its small island, reached by causeway, with a golden seated Buddha looking out over the sea.

activities.name: Na Muang Waterfall
activities.description: Two falls in the island's interior, the lower one an easy walk and the upper one a steeper climb through forest.

stops.name: Krabi
stops.hotel: Holiday Ao Nang Beach Resort, Krabi
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Luxury room · 4★ · Holiday Ao Nang Beach Resort, steps from the beach road

program.name: Seven islands and a plankton swim
program.description: Three nights in Ao Nang with a sunset tour of seven islands, a barbecue dinner on the sand and a free day for the rainforest.

activities.name: Krabi 7 Islands with Barbecue Dinner
activities.description: An afternoon and evening across seven islands by long tail boat, with snorkelling, a barbecue dinner on the beach and a swim with glowing plankton.

activities.name: Wat Tham Sua
activities.description: The Tiger Cave temple, with over twelve hundred steps up to a golden Buddha and a long view across the Krabi plain.

activities.name: The Emerald Pool
activities.description: A spring fed pool in the Khao Phra Bang Khram forest inland from Krabi, clear green and warm all year.

activities.name: Klong Thom Hot Springs
activities.description: Warm water running over smooth rock into forest pools, usually paired with the Emerald Pool on the same drive.
